description: This file defines the CacheInterface in Twig, an interface for cache classes that handle storing and retrieving compiled templates on the filesystem or other storage strategies.

classes.name: Twig\Cache\CacheInterface
classes.description: An interface outlining methods for cache implementations, including generating cache keys, writing templates to cache, loading templates, and retrieving timestamps.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key for a given template class name.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores the compiled template content in the cache under a specified key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Retrieves a template from the cache using a key.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the modification timestamp for a cache key.
